title: 花旗杨霭仪：AI资本开支大超预期，腾讯三年投入6000亿
speaker: Alicia Yapp

segments.en: Well, it is understandable, given it is a really big amount.
segments.zh: 可以理解，因为金额确实很大。

segments.en: It's a big jump, right, this quarter. I think my initial reaction is that, oh, they're actually able to spend.
segments.zh: 本季度增幅很大。我最初的反应是，他们终于能花钱了。

segments.en: Because previously, I think they've been talking about the one or two spend. It's just that they couldn't spend it on the right time, right?
segments.zh: 因为之前他们一直说要投入，只是没在合适的时间花出去。

segments.en: But now, I think finally, they're able to procure, I think the delivery of either the memory chips or some of the GPU from the domestic side.
segments.zh: 但现在，他们终于能采购到内存芯片或部分国产GPU了。

segments.en: This is probably prompting the cap expense number and also the prepayment to secure some of the procurements.
segments.zh: 这推高了资本开支，也产生了预付款以确保采购。

segments.en: It's also results in the outflow for the cash flow this quarter.
segments.zh: 这也导致本季度现金流流出。

segments.en: It's likely not a one-off cap expense.
segments.zh: 这很可能不是一次性的资本开支。

segments.en: So we raised our Quebec's assumption post this quarter.
segments.zh: 本季度后我们上调了资本开支假设。

segments.en: Previously, we were way too conservative, given we haven't seen anything that coming in right the past few quarter.
segments.zh: 之前我们过于保守，因为过去几个季度没看到实际投入。

segments.en: So we are now for 2026, even for the next two quarters, we are raising a 260, 65 billion coming out from the 53 billion.
segments.zh: 我们现在预计2026年及未来两个季度，资本开支将从530亿上调至650亿。

segments.en: So our this year, four year, we are at 200 billion.
segments.zh: 所以今年我们预计为2000亿。

segments.en: And then next two year, we are also above 200 billion.
So that means the next three years, we are actually total about 600 billion.
segments.zh: 这意味着未来三年总计约6000亿。
